about.en: Concrete is an on-chain yield platform built by Blueprint Finance that runs automated vault strategies over deposited assets, and offers an AssetCX product that earns on the same infrastructure while the assets stay with a qualified custodian. CT is its native token, deployed as an ERC-20 with 18 decimals at 0x0A092E544DA31150b439a1aAA1A3a2214a867F46 on both Ethereum and BNB Chain.
